reference_contract.skeleton_sequence: BFS ordered joints represented by 3D position plus parent index

released_diffusion.public_diffloss_effective_sampler_note: Released model/diffloss.py hard-codes timestep_respacing='50' for gen_diffusion despite config.yaml declaring 300; parity must distinguish configuration intent from released executable behavior.

exact_formulation_differences: Does not use RigAnything's released unified point-plus-joint transformer with its hybrid causal attention mask.
Does not use the released RigAnything DiffLoss implementation or its exact learned-variance diffusion parameterization.
Uses custom diffusion width/depth defaults and deterministic DDIM-style sampling rather than the released p_sample_loop implementation.
Does not reproduce RigAnything's self-parent stop sentinel in the challenger forward path.
BFS ambiguity handling exists as a separate randomize_bfs_depth_order_v1 training utility rather than being proof of identical dataset/preprocessing semantics.
Retains RealSaS Compiler authority and richer RiggingSurface conditioning, intentionally diverging from reference product ownership.

allowed_claims: The frozen Geppetto residual diffusion head is not a faithful test of RigAnything joint diffusion.
The negative Knight ablation falsifies benefit of the current residual-output-refinement role on this frozen witness; it does not falsify reference-style joint diffusion.
The historical challenger captured the key sampled-joint causal loop closely enough to remain the correct starting point for a parity-faithful research challenger.
forbidden_claims: The historical challenger is an exact reimplementation of the full RigAnything formulation.
Any source-level parity result authorizes Geppetto refreeze or product promotion.

next_gate.requirement: If reference-style diffusion remains scientifically material, derive the next challenger from the historical absolute-joint sampled-feedback path, explicitly selecting which remaining reference differences to preserve versus intentionally substitute. Do not train until that contract is frozen.
